name: half-built-vo-1
text:
Har shehar mein ek building aadhi bani khadi hai. Saalon se. Kyun?
May do hazaar baais tak, saat bade shehron mein lagbhag chaar point aath lakh ghar atke ya bahut late the. Aadhe sirf NCR mein.
Aur twist? [pause] Jo projects poori tarah ruk gaye... unke lagbhag do-tihai flats pehle hi bik chuke the.
Ghaziabad ka ek project. Chhe hazaar do sau tirepan flats.
Kahani simple hai. Bank teen se chaar saal ka loan deta hai. Project mein saat se aath saal lagte hain.
Paisa beech mein khatam. Phir case. Phir insolvency.
Aur buyer? EMI bhi bharta hai... aur kiraya bhi.
Do hazaar unnees mein sarkar ne ek fund banaya. December do hazaar pachchees tak lagbhag iksath hazaar ghar poore hue.
Send this to anyone paying EMI on a flat that isn't ready.
Agli baar yeh dhaancha dikhe... yaad rakhna. Yeh khaali nahi hai. [whispers] Kisi ka ghar hai.
